label: An actual bearer's degree of esse is the least upper bound of its realized pure levels
paraphrase: Open calibration. In one preorder, each pure determination in the chosen inventory has a bearer-independent level. Each actual bearer's own represented degree of esse bounds the levels of the determinations it really has and lies below every bound on those levels. The inventory and its levels must have a rationale independent of giver and recipient rank. Neither the source's possible outputs nor a count of kinds defines its degree.
